thing.name: a paper fog machine (non-functional) (probably)
thing.body:
A paper fog machine constructed from a toilet roll tube, two cotton balls, and a drawing of wind on an index card taped to the front. When operated (by holding it at arm's length and saying "pshhhh" quietly), it produces no fog whatsoever. The cotton balls do not move. The wind drawing remains still.

However: every actor who has held it reports that the audience seemed slightly further away afterward, and that the next line took longer to arrive. The stage manager's notes record it as "atmospheric delay, source unclear."

It has been used in every production since its arrival, always in the wrong scene. Nobody removes it from the schedule because removing it would require admitting it does nothing, and no one is willing to test that hypothesis during a performance.

Operating instructions: hold, say "pshhhh," wait. Do not look directly at the fog. If asked whether it is working, say "it takes a moment" and change the subject.
